financings_after_balance_sheet.what: August 2026 public offering of shares, pre-funded warrants and Series E warrants
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The aggregate gross proceeds to the Company from the August 2026 Offering were approximately $ 2,500 , while the net proceeds, after transaction costs, were approximately $ 2,100 .

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM share sales in July and August 2026
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In July and August 2026, the Company issued and sold an aggregate of 130,249 ordinary shares for $ 261 , net of transaction costs under the Sales Agreement for the Company's ATM facility

warrants.quote: (a) 399,020 aggregate Series C ordinary warrants and Series D ordinary warrants to purchase up to 399,020 ordinary shares at an exercise price of $ 5.00 per ordinary share
(b) 13,966 placement agent warrants to purchase up to 13,966 ordinary shares at an exercise price of $ 6.25 per ordinary share
The Series E ordinary warrants have an exercise price of $ 0.65 per ordinary share, are immediately exercisable, and may be exercised for five years from issuance.
Those placement agent warrants have an exercise price of $ 0.8125 per ordinary share, are exercisable for five years from the date of issuance
The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at an exercise price of $ 0.0001 per ordinary share and will not expire until exercised in full.
